note: joint-space staging pose commanded before capture; NOT a task pose and not teleoperation. Found by coordinate descent over joints 1, 2, 4 and 6 against a cost that encodes hands in front of the chest, lateral extent about the torso's, elbows below the shoulders and a level wrist, with clearance to the wearer measured GEOMETRICALLY (the SRDF excludes the pairs that matter, so /check_state_validity is not the authority on it). The cost also measures the APEX of the whole limb against the wearer's shoulder line, because an elbow can be below the shoulder at the joint being measured while the limb still climbs over the shoulders in the picture -- which is what the 2026-08-13 render showed and no joint-level term saw.
